rationale: A wins because it knows the difference between a story and a hypothesis. Its line "nothing in the facts confirms smart-cart data feeds ad targeting" keeps the weakest bridge properly fenced off; B turns the same unsupported bridge into "A cart that watches what you put in it is now the grocery aisle's newest ad surface," which is a headline in search of a fact. B has sharper proof lists and a useful CPG-budget angle, but ground truth beats copy heat every time.
gaps_in_A: "Instacart's smart-cart rollout turns it into checkout infrastructure for grocery chains" overstates the deployment; a few hundred stores is not yet infrastructure unless the commercial model and adoption breadth are proven.

"a spokesperson quote confirming that advertising is becoming the primary growth engine" is the wrong proof standard. A reporter needs revenue mix, growth rate, and margin data, not a company quote baptizing the thesis.
The second and third angles both ride the same smart-cart expansion fact; "More grocery chains are letting..." and "checkout infrastructure" are distinct enough to workshop, but still adjacent.
A buries the advertiser-side story. "ads come from over 6,000 consumer brands" appears as support, but there is a real CPG/brand-budget protagonist there that A mostly leaves on the table.
gaps_in_B: "A cart that watches what you put in it is now the grocery aisle's newest ad surface" is not in the update. The facts say carts track items and Instacart sells ads; they do not say carts serve ads or feed ad products.
"The prevailing belief in retail media is that ad revenue rides on top of a growing transaction base" may be smart, but it is unsourced outside scaffolding, not supplied fact.
"this beat has already seen fail twice" is invented color. If you cannot name the failed attempts from the provided evidence, keep it out.

"a few hundred stores across a 1,500-plus banner network — meaning the vast majority of banners have not deployed them" compares stores to banners and turns a likely limitation into a cleaner fact than the update gives you.
